page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, indicating that hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-CPU ratio of 1.0 GB per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A key technical characteristic of the ecs.s3.medium is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets. Hardware flags for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI) are not available. This lack of specialized vector and matrix instructions limits its performance in mathematical modeling, machine learning inference, and cryptographic operations. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing power, but the 1:1 GB RAM-to-vCPU ratio represents a significant constraint for memory-intensive applications.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a cost-efficient entry point for workloads requiring multiple dedicated physical cores without the overhead of large memory allocations. It is suited for lightweight, CPU-bound tasks with minimal memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include basic web serving, simple batch processing, and lightweight microservices that do not require advanced instruction sets or local storage.
